title: ECB cuts rates with other central banks and lends without limit
detail: A coordinated cut with the Federal Reserve and four other central banks; weekly refinancing operations move to a fixed rate with full allotment.

title: ECB starts buying government and private debt
detail: The Securities Markets Programme: interventions in euro area public and private debt securities markets that had become dysfunctional.

title: ECB announces three-year loans to banks
detail: Two longer-term refinancing operations with a maturity of 36 months, and a cut in the reserve ratio from 2% to 1%.

title: ECB sets out Outright Monetary Transactions
detail: Purchases in secondary sovereign bond markets, conditional on an EFSF/ESM programme, with no limit set in advance.

title: ECB takes its deposit rate below zero
detail: The deposit facility rate is cut to -0.10%; targeted longer-term refinancing operations (TLTROs) are announced the same day.

title: ECB announces government bond purchases
detail: The expanded asset purchase programme: €60 billion a month, adding bonds of euro area central governments, agencies and European institutions.

title: ECB raises purchases to €80 billion a month
detail: The deposit rate is cut to -0.40%, monthly purchases are expanded, and investment-grade corporate bonds become eligible.

title: ECB ends net asset purchases
detail: Net purchases under the asset purchase programme end in December 2018; maturing securities continue to be reinvested.

title: ECB cuts to -0.50% and restarts purchases
detail: The deposit facility rate is cut by 10 basis points and net purchases restart at €20 billion a month from November.

title: ECB announces the pandemic purchase programme
detail: The Pandemic Emergency Purchase Programme: a temporary €750 billion programme of private and public sector securities.

title: ECB raises rates for the first time since 2011
detail: The three key rates rise by 50 basis points, taking the deposit rate to 0.00%; the Transmission Protection Instrument is approved.

title: ECB announces runoff of its bond portfolio
detail: Rates rise by 50 basis points; from March 2023 the asset purchase programme portfolio declines by €15 billion a month on average.

title: ECB raises its deposit rate to 4.00%
detail: The three key rates rise by 25 basis points; this is the last increase of the cycle.

title: ECB begins cutting rates
detail: The three key rates are lowered by 25 basis points after nine months of holding steady.

title: ECB cuts its deposit rate to 2.00%
detail: The three key rates are lowered by 25 basis points; this is the last cut of the cycle.

title: ECB raises rates again
detail: The three key rates rise by 25 basis points, citing inflation pressures from the war in the Middle East.
